perPage.descriptionPreview: Addition worksheets for kindergarten and grade 1: visual counting and single-digit sums. Play interactively in browser or print the PDF.
Picture sudoku worksheets for K-3: 4x4 grids that use animal and object images instead of numbers. Logical deduction at an early-years level.
Cryptogram puzzles for grade 1 through grade 3: crack the symbol-to-letter cipher to reveal each hidden word. Picture clues guide young decoders.
Picture path maze worksheets for K-3: drag through the grid using up, down, left, and right moves only to reach the goal. Spatial planning practice.
Subtraction worksheets for kindergarten and grade 1: cross out the pictures to see take-away in action before the minus symbol appears.
Code addition worksheets for grade 1 and grade 2: decode the letter cipher, then add the matched numbers. Reading and math in one activity.
More or less worksheets for pre-K and kindergarten: compare two groups by counting pictures before the greater-than and less-than symbols arrive.
Math puzzle worksheets for kindergarten and grade 1: drag the missing piece into each visual equation. A playful path into algebraic thinking.
Mixed-operation math worksheets for grade 1 and grade 2: addition, subtraction, and fill-in algebra on a single practice page. Print or play.
Biggest and smallest worksheets for ages 3-5: tap the larger or smaller item in each group. Picture-based, so no reading is needed.
Bar chart and tally worksheets for kindergarten through grade 2: count the pictures, fill in the chart columns. First steps in data literacy.
Pattern train worksheets for preschool and pre-K: drag picture cards onto each wagon to finish the AB or ABC sequence. Pre-algebra in disguise.
Pattern worksheets for kindergarten and grade 1: fill the blank in ABAB and ABCABC picture sequences. Print for centers or play interactively.
Classroom bingo cards for kindergarten and grade 1: picture, letter, and number variants for whole-class review. Print sets or call rounds online.
Grid match puzzles for kindergarten and grade 1: drag each picture piece into the correct grid cell to rebuild the full image. Spatial reasoning.
Matching worksheets for preschool and pre-K: tap the picture on the left, then tap its pair on the right to draw the connecting line.
Picture sort worksheets for kindergarten and grade 1: drag each image into the bin where it belongs. Classification by attribute, made visible.
Shadow match worksheets for preschool and kindergarten: pair each colorful picture with its black silhouette. Trains visual discrimination.
Alphabet train worksheets for preschool and pre-K: drag letter cards onto wagons to put A-Z in order. Available in 11 languages and printable.
Prepositions worksheets for pre-K and kindergarten: choose the picture that shows in, on, under, behind, or next to. Spatial language in 11 languages.
Word guess worksheets for kindergarten and grade 1: fill the hangman-style letter blanks using the picture clue. Letter-sound decoding for new readers.
Word scramble worksheets for kindergarten and grade 1: rearrange the letters to spell what the picture shows. Strengthens phonics and letter recall.
Word search worksheets for K-3: drag across the letter grid to find each hidden word. Picture clues help emerging readers spot targets quickly.
Picture crossword worksheets for K-3: image clues replace text prompts so emerging readers can spell across and down. Play online or print.
Find-and-count worksheets for kindergarten and grade 1: spot every item in a busy scene, tap to mark, then record the total per category.
I-Spy and find-the-object scenes for ages 4-7: hunt for items hidden among busy details, training visual discrimination and focus.
Treasure hunt worksheets for grade 1 and grade 2: read direction clues like two east, one north to navigate from start to the hidden treasure square.
Missing pieces puzzles for preschool and kindergarten: drag each shape into the matching cutout. Part-whole reasoning for early childhood.
Odd-one-out worksheets for kindergarten and grade 1: tap the picture that does not belong in each set. Practice classification by attribute.
Animals worksheets supporting K-3 vocabulary growth, habitat classification, and living-things reasoning through richly illustrated activity sets.
Preschool worksheets for ages 3-5: vocabulary picture matching, color and shape recognition, simple sorting. Free for Pre-K, child care, and TK rooms.
Kindergarten worksheets for letter-sound matching, counting to 20, sight words, and single-digit addition. Great for morning work and literacy centers.
Grade 1 worksheets for CVC decoding, place value, addition within 20, and picture-clue reading. CCSS-aligned activities playable online or printable.
Grade 2 worksheets covering regrouping math, multi-syllable reading, bar charts, and skip counting. Resources for classroom teachers and homeschool parents.
